Stream-time expanders under `BO1_PORT_X64`: zone + content core + **Weapon/Menu** + remaining content leaves (SndDriverGlobals/PackIndex/XGlobals/DDL/Emblem/ImpactFx). See `docs/port/fastfile_32_to_64.md`.
